title: Sol 6.2 的代码审查堪称神级
author: Jonathan Ellis
content:
In You're Paying too much for Code Review, I showed how agents armed with just a straightforward prompt could outperform commercial review services at a fraction of the cost.

Since then we've tested the following additional models:

  1. Kimi K3.1 Pro
  2. Muse Ember
  3. Grok 4.7
  4. Gemini 4 Hydrogen
  5. Sol 6.2

We found that Terra 6.1 still owns the low-cost side of the Pareto frontier, but surprisingly, it's Sol 6.2 that wins if you're willing to pay more money for a more-thorough review.

("Surprisingly" because Hydrogen, Sonnet, and Opus all out-code Sol 6.2, and so does Sol 6.1. But Sol 6.2 is a beast at code review.)

Here is each model in isolation, findings vs cost; cost is log-scale. (Thus, the most expensive bare-model reviewer, Hydrogen/high, was still only half the price of a Greptile base review.) See the original post for details on the evaluation.

And here they are in combinations of up to three, breaking out low-, medium-, and high-impact findings and discarding the non-frontier options:

And by latency:

Finally, a visualization combining both cost and latency; mouse over the points for details.

Low+ review findings

To my eye the best tradeoff across findings, cost, and latency are is combining two of the best individuals: Sol 6.2/medium + Terra 6.1/xhigh at 222 findings for $0.28 per review and 111s. If you're in a hurry, drop both down an effort level; Sol 6.2/low + Terra 6.1/high, 165 findings for $0.20 per review and 55s. Compare Greptile at 117 for $1 and 147s.

How to configure multiple reviewers in Mjolnir

You can set up Sol and Terra as reviewers in the mjolnir control plane (free and Apache licensed) in Settings -> Code Review:

Clicking on Autoconfigure picks the best reviewers available in your configured profiles.

Mjolnir automatically adds code review tools to your harnesses via MCP, and enforces that the current HEAD has had a clean review with a git push hook. Reviewers run concurrently, and the primary agent is given findings as they arrive, so it doesn't have to wait for a slow review to get started on a faster one's feedback.

You can configure any model you like as reviewer, but Sol and Terra are dominant enough that you should probably sign up for a $20 Codex plan just to get them. (Even paying API prices is cheaper than a standalone tool like Greptile.)

How to configure multiple reviewers in SlopCop

The SlopCop CLI is also free and Apache licensed, and local LLM review works standalone with no SlopCop account required. Running slopcop init picks the best reviewers available, like mjolnir's autoconfigure, or you can pin your choices manually with e.g. slopcop config set review.reviewers terra/high,sol/low.
aiSummary: 本文对多款 AI 代码审查模型进行了基准测试，发现 Sol 6.2 在兼顾成本和速度时能提供最全面的审查，并针对不同预算和延迟限制推荐了具体的模型组合。
oneSentenceSummary: 本文对多款 AI 代码审查模型进行了基准测试，发现 Sol 6.2 在兼顾成本和速度时能提供最全面的审查，并针对不同预算和延迟限制推荐了具体的模型组合。
summary: 本文对多款 AI 代码审查模型进行了全面基准测试，包括 Kimi K3.1 Pro、Muse Ember、Grok 4.7、Gemini 4 Hydrogen 和 Sol 6.2，并比较了它们的成本与延迟表现。测试结果显示，Terra 6.1 在低成本领域表现突出；而在预算允许的情况下，Sol 6.2 则是进行全面审查的更佳选择。文章通过图表展示了发现数量与成本（对数刻度）及延迟之间的关系，并指出，若要以每次审查 $0.28 的成本获得最多发现，可将 Sol 6.2/medium 与 Terra 6.1/xhigh 组合使用；若希望更快完成审查，则可选择 Sol 6.2/low 与 Terra 6.1/high，成本为每次审查 $0.20。这些组合的表现大幅优于 Greptile 等商业工具；Greptile 每次审查花费 $1、耗时 147 秒，却只能发现 117 个问题。文章还介绍了如何通过免费的 Mjolnir 控制平面或 SlopCop CLI 配置这些审查工具。

mainPoints.point: 预算允许时，Sol 6.2 在代码审查方面优于其他 AI 模型，能发现最全面的问题。
mainPoints.explanation: 多模型基准测试表明，Sol 6.2 的代码审查质量更高，因此尽管成本较高，它仍是全面分析的首选。

mainPoints.point: 将 Sol 6.2 与 Terra 6.1 组合使用，可在全面性、成本和延迟之间取得最佳平衡。
mainPoints.explanation: 性价比最高的组合是 Sol 6.2/medium + Terra 6.1/xhigh：每次审查耗时 111s、成本 $0.28，可发现 222 个问题。若选择 Sol 6.2/low + Terra 6.1/high，则可在 55 秒内以 $0.20 的成本发现 165 个问题。

mainPoints.point: AI 代码审查不仅能显著优于 Greptile 等商业方案，成本也更低。
mainPoints.explanation: 基准测试显示，即使是成本最高的单模型审查器 Hydrogen/high，价格也只有 Greptile 基础审查的一半，却能发现多得多的问题。

mainPoints.point: Mjolnir 和 SlopCop 提供免费的开源控制平面，可用于配置和管理 AI 代码审查工作流。
mainPoints.explanation: 这两款工具都提供 Apache 许可的审查工具配置方案：Mjolnir 提供网页界面，SlopCop CLI 则可在本地使用 LLM 进行审查，无需注册账号。

keyQuotes: Sol 6.2 的代码审查堪称神级
Terra 6.1 仍然主宰着帕累托前沿的低成本一侧；但令人意外的是，如果你愿意多花一些钱来获得更全面的审查，胜出的会是 Sol 6.2。
在发现数量、成本和延迟之间，最佳的权衡是组合两款表现最出色的模型：Sol 6.2/medium + Terra 6.1/xhigh，每次审查可发现 222 个问题，成本为 $0.28，耗时 111s。
即使按 API 价格付费，也比 Greptile 这样的独立工具便宜。
